Q1: What should this issue do about the third failing job (the closed-reader test at `tests/test_gh_retry_stdout_isolation.py:242`, which gets `rc=0` because uutils `cat` exits 0 on a closed pipe)?
Choices:
A) Leave it out. Fix only the two listed files and let the open PRs (#9246, #9264, #9267) handle the closed-reader test. PR #9265's CI stays red until one of them merges. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Add it to this issue: also fix the closed-reader test or the `gh_retry` closed-pipe handling, overlapping the open PRs.
C) Add it only as a test-side change: make the assertion accept the uutils `cat` behaviour, with no change to `gh_retry`.
Q2: Open PR #9246 ("heartbeat clock", touching `tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py` and `ci.yml`) and #9271 (touching `tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_purge_safety.py`) may already fix the same lines. How should this issue handle that overlap?
Choices:
A) Go ahead anyway with the smallest test-only edits the issue suggests (make `_recent_doc()` never return `CASES.REPORT`; change `\d+` to `-?\d+` at lines 4662 and 4669) and accept a possible merge conflict or no-op later. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Fix only the purge-safety date collision here and leave the elapsed-time regex to #9246.
C) Make no code change; close this issue as a duplicate of #9246 and #9271.
